# The AI Docs Lab

> The AI Docs Lab builds custom, AI-powered landing pages for coaches, consultants, and service professionals. Each page includes a 24/7 trained AI chatbot and an AI crawler plugin that makes the page discoverable by AI search engines and assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity), not just Google.

## Key facts

- Price: $297, one-time. No monthly software fees.
- Delivery: within 48 hours of an application being reviewed and confirmed.
- Every application is personally reviewed by Dr. Eric within 24 hours.
- Weekly capacity: 5 new builds per week, because every page is built, reviewed, and positioned by one person rather than a team.
- Guarantee: if the reviewer does not believe a page can be built that converts for the applicant, the applicant is told honestly and refunded instantly.
- What's included: custom landing page, conversion copywriting, a 24/7 trained AI chatbot, an AI crawler plugin, a lead capture form, booking integration, a free domain, and the first 30 days of hosting.
- Who it's for: coaches, consultants, and service professionals who have real client results but no landing page, or a landing page that isn't generating leads.

- [Live demo](https://theaidocslabdemolandingpage.netlify.app/): a working example page with an embedded, real AI chatbot visitors can talk to directly (no email required), followed by the application form to get a custom page built.
